import swIcon1 from '../images/service/icon-1.png'

import swIcon3 from '../images/service/icon-3.png'
import swIcon4 from '../images/service/icon-4.png'
import swIcon5 from '../images/service/icon-5.png'



const Services = [
    {
        Id: '1',
        sIcon:swIcon1,
        title: 'Photography',
        slug: 'Web-UI-UX-Design',
        description:'Professional photography for weddings, events, and portraits.',
        des2:'Capturing beautiful moments with high-quality photography services for all occasions.',
    },
    {
        Id: '2',
        sIcon:swIcon2,
        title: 'Graphic Design',
        slug: 'Mobile-UI-UX-Design',
        description:'Creative design solutions for your brand and marketing needs.',
        des2:'Professional graphic design services including logos, branding, and marketing materials.',
    },
    {
        Id: '3',
        sIcon:swIcon3,
        title: 'Videography',
        slug: 'Branding-Design',
        description:'Cinematic video production for events and promotional content.',
        des2:'Professional videography services capturing your special moments in stunning detail.',
    },
    {
        Id: '4',
        sIcon:swIcon4,
        title: 'Portrait Painting',
        slug: 'Creative-Design',
        description:'Custom hand-painted portraits on canvas for lasting memories.',
        des2:'Unique portrait painting services creating beautiful artwork of your loved ones.',
    },
    {
        Id: '5',
        sIcon:swIcon5,
        title: 'Movement',
        slug: 'Movement',
        description:'Dynamic visual storytelling through motion and creativity.',
        des2:'Bringing your vision to life with creative movement and visual effects.',

]    

export default Services;
